title: WordPress.com Launches Free Student Plan to Train Next-Gen Web Creators
summary: WordPress.com, operated by Automattic, introduces WordPress.com Education, a free plan for students and teachers. The program provides full WordPress.com domains, free domain names (.blog or .art), and plugin support without requiring a credit card. It includes 6 GB storage, backups, staging sites, and tools like SFTP/SSH and phpMyAdmin. The initiative aims to integrate WordPress into classrooms, improving students' employability and entrepreneurial skills. After the first free year, students can continue for $2/month or downgrade to a free plan while retaining their work.
key_points: WordPress.com Education is a free plan for students and teachers, launched by Automattic.
Includes a full WordPress.com domain, free .blog or .art domain, and plugin support without a credit card requirement.
Features 6 GB storage, backups, staging sites, SFTP/SSH, phpMyAdmin, and Studio Sync.
Piloted with 5,000 students across 27 countries; 88.9% of educators reported improved student employability.
After the first free year, students can subscribe for $2/month or downgrade to a free plan while keeping their work intact.
Aims to train the next generation of web professionals and integrate WordPress into underfunded schools.
